pay_detail: Free. Food and lodging are covered.
notes: The page does not state the exact day it opens or closes. Only people who live in Indiana can join.
name: Factor Future Educator Program (IU School of Education)
org: School of Education, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: One week living on campus to explore teaching and school counseling careers. Sessions with faculty and current students, plus a look at college life.
who_can_apply: Current Indiana high school juniors on a college-prep path. That means the Indiana GPS Diploma or GPS Diploma Plus. You need a 3.0 or higher cumulative GPA. You should like teaching, counseling or student services.
deadline_text: Program is July 11 to 17, 2027. The page says applications will open in February 2027. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: The online application opens in February 2027. Use the link on the page to ask for more info and get updates.
